title: Antimicrobial Coverage for Material That Stood Wet (Water Damage Mitigation)
content:
Water Damage Mitigation application standard. Material that stood wet longer takes a heavier antimicrobial application, expressed as a coverage factor by which the treated area of the tear-out antimicrobial line is multiplied: when the job's opened date is two or more days after its loss date the coverage factor is 1.5, when it is exactly one day after the loss date the coverage factor is 1.25, and when the job was opened on its loss date no stood-wet coverage applies.

The loss date and the opened date are those on the job record, and the gap is counted in calendar days.

## Both sides of each threshold (hypothetical loss on the 12th)
| Opened on | Days after the loss | Coverage factor under this standard |
|---|---|---|
| the 12th | 0 | none |
| the 13th | 1 | 1.25 |
| the 14th | 2 | 1.5 |
| the 20th | 8 | 1.5 |

## Illustration (hypothetical)
A treated area of 800 square feet on a job opened the day after the loss becomes 1000 square feet under a coverage factor of 1.25; on a job opened two days after the loss it becomes 1200 square feet.
